scientific_integrity: Analytic proof and exact derivative checks supplied; numerical tests are only corroboration. General fixed-point theorems explicitly attributed. No independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic active-population mass-action SIRD, finite fully positive group mixing and positive initial infectious seed; no stochastic interpretation or exact optimal convergence factor. Abstract positive-concave uniqueness/geometric convergence already known. One older relevant epidemiological article was accessible by abstract only.
title: Parameter-unrestricted final-size uniqueness and certified geometric bracketing in active-population SIRD networks
